# Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animal Pack

Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html

Included files used by TRip:

- `Deer.fbx`
- `Stag.fbx`
- `Wolf.fbx`

Author: Quaternius (`@Quaternius`)

License: CC0 1.0 Universal / Public Domain Dedication. The original
`LICENSE.txt` is stored beside the assets.

The pack is used as a replaceable production-quality animated silhouette
layer. TRip's ecology, behavior, collision and narrative contracts remain in
project-owned data and scripts.
